title: Plant Reproduction
seo_title: Primary 5 Basic Science and Technology: Plant Reproduction Worksheets (NERDC)
standard_code: Primary 5 Basic Science and Technology: Living and Non-Living Things
standard_text: Flowering plants reproduce sexually through flowers: pollination, fertilisation, and seed and fruit formation; seeds are dispersed and germinate. Some plants reproduce asexually from stems, roots or leaves. (summary of the Basic Science and Technology curriculum, Primary 5, theme: Living and Non-Living Things)
meta_desc: Free Primary 5 Basic Science and Technology worksheets (NERDC curriculum, theme: Living and Non-Living Things): parts of a flower, pollination, seed dispersal, germination and asexual reproduction. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Some plants grow from stems, roots or leaves.
body_html:
How to think about it

The flower is the reproductive part of a plant. The stamen (anther and filament) makes pollen; the pistil (stigma, style and ovary) holds the ovules. Pollination moves pollen to the stigma by wind, insects or birds. After fertilisation the ovule becomes a seed and the ovary becomes a fruit.

Some plants reproduce without seeds (asexual reproduction): new sweet potato plants grow from roots, sugarcane from stem cuttings, kalanchoe from leaves, and bananas from suckers. The young plants are like the parent.

Example

Which part of the flower becomes the fruit?

It holds the ovules.

Answer: the ovary

Example

How does a banana plant make new plants?

From the base of the plant

Answer: from suckers (asexual)

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up pollination and fertilisation.
  • Thinking only animals reproduce.
  • Thinking all plants need seeds to reproduce.

items.e: The ovary contains the ovules and becomes the fruit.

items.q: “The seeds are dispersed and can grow into new plants.” What happened just before?

A bee visits a flower and pollen sticks to its body.

items.q: Does a seed need light to germinate?
c: No. A seed can germinate without it.
Yes, but only in the day.

items.e: Seeds can germinate on wet cotton wool in the dark. They need light later, when the young plant grows.

Only if it is a big seed.
items.e: Seeds need water, warmth and air to germinate. They use food stored inside them until their leaves grow.
